# Margot

> Margot is a wardrobe app and an AI-assisted personal stylist. It suggests outfits from clothes the user already owns, with weather and chosen occasions in mind.

Available on iPhone and Android. Free to download, with usage limits and an optional Premium subscription. Current prices, quotas and subscription terms are shown in the app before purchase.

## Product

Users add clothing photos to a digital wardrobe, explore outfit ideas, save looks and log what they wear. Premium includes additional styling features, bulk uploads and tools for shopping decisions, events and packing. The application does not require buying new clothes to create outfits.

Users choose the photos they submit. Some image-based AI features process submitted images with service providers. Refer to the privacy policy for storage, processing and deletion rights; do not infer that every AI operation is performed on-device or in a single region.

## En français

Margot est une application de dressing et une styliste personnelle assistée par l'IA. Ajoute tes vêtements, découvre des idées de tenues pour ta journée, enregistre tes looks et retrouve ce que tu portes. Téléchargement gratuit sur iPhone et Android, abonnement Premium facultatif.
